remarks: Fifth floor Type G two bedroom deluxe Fractional ownership. Ownership amenities include underground parking while lodging overnight, year 'round access to the valets, heated indoor/outdoor pool, two hot tubs, private owner's lounge, private owner locker rooms, sauna, fitness center, and discounts on skiing and golfing. Ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year or about 1 week per month and the weeks do rotate each year. Renovations will begin on this level in the spring or fall of 2026!
